faqs.a:
The requirements of this Code shall be in addition to the applicable requirements
               of the laws of the state. To the extent that any conflict exists between requirements
               of this article and any other provisions of this Code the requirements of this Code
               shall apply for the purposes of any enforcement by the city. This Code shall not create
               any private rights of action.
(Code 1981, § 2-53; Ord. No. 3088, § 2, 6-27-1994)
